what: ML-AM-NEXT-LIVE follow-up. In RQ-20261029-a7e1-01 (FAIL), the matched-random control is a 50% partial close at a uniformly drawn bar on ~55% of trades, and it scored on the TD family (n=1831 OOS trades, CPCV over 2020-07-01..2026-10-15, 2000 random draws) median +0.0146 R/trade with a 29.0% book maxDD cut. The ML head scored -0.0338 with 17.8% (PB2H, n=796 trades, random: -0.0087, 10.0%). This is a control-arm observation, not a result of that unit, and must not be shipped on it. Author a pre-registered unit for a STATIC mid-trade de-risk partial close (e.g. 50% at a fixed fraction of the leg's median hold, or at bar k), graded under RULE-AM-RISK-ADJUSTED-V1 + non-inferiority + matched random + best static on the TD real-money legs, with a window none of this lane's runs used (or CPCV with the rule fixed before the run). A static rule is not ML, so it answers the operator's active-management milestone, not 'next ML live'.
